about_the_game:
"Do not forget what you are... a machine."

Memento Machinam is a survival horror experience that plunges you into the heart of a dystopian city consumed by chaos. A hybrid biomechanical virus has ravaged the world, blurring the line between humanity and machine.

Step into a dark and visceral cyberpunk universe, where every decision pushes the limits of survival. With an immersive narrative, cutting-edge design, and gameplay mechanics that challenge the boundaries of the genre, Memento Machinam aims to redefine what survival horror can be.

  • An Unique Cyberpunk Setting: Our universe delves into a dystopian future where computer malware transcends technological boundaries, infiltrating and corrupting organic beings.

  • Top Notch VFX & Visuals: Our dedicated team has poured countless hours into crafting visually stunning, original characters, menacing enemies, and immersive environments that bring our dystopian world to life.

  • Original Mechanics: The game combines timeless survival horror elements with modern innovations, offering challenging resource management, ingenious puzzles, and encounters with enigmatic enemies designed to test your skills.

  • Deep Narrative: A story with unexpected twists, complex characters, and themes like Transhumanism, Dehumanization and Corporate Manipulation.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version 1909 or later
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 760 or AMD Radeon™ R7 260x with 2GB Video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound

short_description: A cyberpunk survival horror set in a dystopian city devastated by a biomechanical malware outbreak. Fight deadly enemies and bosses, solve puzzles, and explore a world consumed by corruption. Classic survival horror mechanics meet modern innovations in a relentless fight for survival.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese
*languages with full audio support
